title: 4권 6유닛 장면 · 1
prompt: Flat vector illustration in the style of a modern children's English textbook: simple geometric shapes, bold flat solid colors, at most one flat darker shadow tone per object, clean smooth edges with no outlines or only very thin dark outlines, rounded friendly forms, no texture, no gradients, no watercolor, no paper grain, no photo-realism, no 3D render. Bright cheerful palette (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, sky blue). Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere in the image. Full illustrated scene: the background is made of a few large flat color shapes (ground, bushes, sky) with a calm plain sky area near the top, characters large and clearly visible. No text, no letters. Do NOT draw any speech bubbles, thought bubbles or empty white balloons of any kind. Letter trees are ordinary round leafy trees with small fruits (like an orchard); never shape trees, clouds, paths or any object like letters of the alphabet. One single continuous picture: never split it into panels, frames or a collage, and draw each character only once. Use the attached character sheet ONLY to copy how the characters look. Draw ONLY these characters: Pip, Bun, Hedgie, Fairy E. Every other character on the sheet must NOT appear in this picture. Scene: A big toy room high in the castle. A toy train track runs around the room and a small red toy train with open carriages sits on it. A grey rain cloud has floated in through the window and pours rain right onto the train, and the carriages fill with water. A blue jay bird shelters under a wooden tray; a round bale of hay gets soggy. Bun holds her red cape over her head; Hedgie points at the cloud; Pip reads the word in two pieces, puzzled; Fairy E shakes water off her bubble wings. Hidden in the picture: the rain, the train, the tray, the jay, the hay. Grumble does NOT appear. No letters anywhere. Characters: Pip is a small round yellow baby songbird standing on tiny orange feet, big sparkling black eyes with rosy cheeks, a cowlick of three little feathers on top of the head, a cream-colored belly patch shaped like a musical note, short stubby wings held like little arms, a small orange beak closed shyly, wearing a single small green leaf tied around its neck like a scarf. Bun is a small white rabbit standing on two legs, one long ear flopped down, green rain boots, brave smile. Hedgie is a small round hedgehog with BRIGHT ORANGE spikes (never brown), a peach-colored face and cream belly, standing on two legs, one tiny blue flower stuck in the spikes, curious cautious eyes. Fairy E is a tiny palm-sized fairy glowing with soft golden light, a round rosy face with big sparkling eyes, short wavy lilac hair, a little dress made of pale-green leaf petals, two round see-through wings like soap bubbles, holding a thin wand tipped with a small yellow star, no letters or symbols drawn anywhere on her or her wand.
